guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent:
The Dockerfile fails at Step 6 while attempting to download and install Maven 3.9. This is due to the URL https://dlcdn.apache.org/maven/maven-3/3.9.5/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.5-bin.tar.gz returning a 404 error (resource not found). To fix the issue, update the Dockerfile to use the correct and verified URL for downloading Maven. Visit the official Maven download page (https://maven.apache.org/download.cgi) to identify the latest and functioning URL for Maven binaries. Update the Dockerfile as follows:

RUN wget <correct_url_to_maven_binary> -O apache-maven.tar.gz && \
    tar xzvf apache-maven.tar.gz -C /opt && \
    ln -s /opt/apache-maven-<version> /opt/maven && \
    rm apache-maven.tar.gz

Replace `<correct_url_to_maven_binary>` and `<version>` with the valid URL and version number available from the Apache Maven site.
